title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：vehicle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vehicle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the driver ① drove the vehicle that no passenger in the station would have described, and he said the driving was the whole of the day. The ② vehicle, meaning the machine itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed undescribed in the book; a vehicle, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ vehicle in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ vehicle at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A vehicle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the driver said the describing is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the vehicle was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the machine. The ⑥ vehicle, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; vehicle, he said, is either something you drive or the only word that means both a machine and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ vehicle had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ vehicle of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of describing; vehicle, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ vehicle I remember is the machine described in the timetable, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ vehicle, my mother said in 1973, is the only machine that improves by being described; every vehicle, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 车辆；交通工具（指车站里每一辆旁边的那一辆）
B. n. 车辆；交通工具（指那辆车辆本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：drive the vehicle 开这一辆车辆
D. n. 车辆；交通工具（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 车辆之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的车辆之事）
F. n. 车辆；交通工具（指时刻表里写到、被描述的那一辆）
G. n. 车辆、行止（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 行止（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: drove the vehicle that no passenger in the station would have described
The vehicle, meaning the machine itself and not the ticket
the vehicle at the far platform
the vehicle was the whole of the matter
the vehicle had become a line in a timetable
The vehicle of the whole thing
A vehicle, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: drive the vehicle 意为“开这一辆车辆”，1964 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯描述的一辆车辆做了一遍。
vehicle 意为“车辆；交通工具”，指那辆车辆本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被描述。
vehicle 意为“车辆；交通工具”，指车站里每一辆旁边的那一辆，每一辆旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
vehicle 意为“车辆；交通工具”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
vehicle 意为“车辆、行止”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这辆行止就是那件事的全部。
vehicle 意为“行止”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那辆车辆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
vehicle 意为“车辆；交通工具”，指时刻表里写到、被描述的那一辆，到 1969 年这一辆成了时刻表里的一行。
vehicle 意为“车辆之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的车辆之事是一处车站和三个日子的描述。
vehicle 意为“车辆；交通工具”，我记得的是时刻表里描述过的那一辆，1971 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一辆。
vehicle 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，车辆是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的车辆。

那辆车辆，指的是那辆车辆本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被描述。（vehicle）
